question: Should this roadmap remain the canonical bundled Control UI/Gateway dashboard coordination item, and which child slices should move to plugin or ClawHub ownership before implementation?
rationale: The issue crosses product direction, plugin API boundaries, sandbox/write-back security, persistent state, publishing trust, and multi-user visibility decisions that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Tracker And Sequence Children
options.body: Keep this roadmap open and require focused review of each linked child issue and PR before any bundled dashboard capability lands.

options.title: Split Optional Slices Outward
options.body: Retain only generic Control UI/Gateway seams in core and route optional widget packs, skills, gallery, or registry work to plugins or ClawHub.

options.title: Pause The Roadmap
options.body: Leave child work unmerged or close the tracker if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboard expansion is not current product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Tracker And Sequence Children
recommendation.body: Keep this roadmap open and require focused review of each linked child issue and PR before any bundled dashboard capability lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current roadmap text and most live implementation branches, making them the best first routing candidate before broader maintainer approval.
